title: Multiplayer Sprint B foundation — research spike + protocol extensions
notes: GDP-2026-05-22-011 (MUST, deferred S115) is a multi-sprint undertaking — 67 acceptance hints, 7 systems to migrate server-side. Breaking it into a foundation sprint (spike + protocol contract) followed by per-system migration sprints.

S116 ships: (1) docs/research/kaboom-multiplayer-sprint-b-plan.md with concrete architecture decisions; (2) schemas/protocol.schema.json extensions covering all 9 new message kinds called out in the spike. Implementation across multiple subsequent sprints.

stories.title: Sprint B migration plan — server-side ECS architecture + system ordering + protocol shapes
stories.summary: Decide before code: where does the kaboom-crew rules module LIVE (server-only? shared library? extracted package?), which order to migrate systems (suggested: protocol contract first, then bomb-placement + bomb-fuse, then blast-propagation, then pickup-spawn/collect, then round-resolve, then bot-AI), how the server-side ECS bootstraps (existing engine ECS in node?), how the seeded RNG flows (one seed per world stored server-side), what the client predicts (movement only, not bomb placement), how the existing bot-vs-bot regression test ports to the server. Output: docs/research/kaboom-multiplayer-sprint-b-plan.md (~300 lines, 8-10 sections). Concrete enough to open the next 4-5 sprints with their scope pre-locked.
verification: acceptance: docs/research/kaboom-multiplayer-sprint-b-plan.md ships and covers 10 required sections — current state, architecture options + recommendation (Option B: shared rules module), system migration ordering across 4 sprint chunks (S117/S118/S119/S120), 9 protocol message kind table, client prediction strategy, determinism + bot-vs-bot port, profile/URL wiring, hard-perimeter out-of-scope list, 5 named risks. The next 4 sprints can open with their scope pre-locked.
Locks the per-sprint scope: S117 protocol+placement+fuse, S118 blast+blocks, S119 pickup+round-resolve, S120 bot-AI
9 protocol message kinds enumerated with exact payload shapes (used as the contract for FEAT-MP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSIONS-001 in S116)

stories.title: Protocol contract — 9 new message kinds for server-authoritative Kaboom Crew
stories.summary: Extend schemas/protocol.schema.json with the new message kinds called out in the spike (placeBombRequest, detonateRemoteRequest, inputIntent c→s; blastEvent, pickupCollected, bomberDied, shieldConsumed, roundResolved, blockDestroyed s→c). Schema only — no system implementation. Adds protocol-validator coverage. Unit tests assert each new message round-trips through validateProtocolMessage. The 4 existing message kinds stay untouched (backcompat).
verification: acceptance: 9 new protocol message kinds added to schemas/protocol.schema.json per the §4 contract in docs/research/kaboom-multiplayer-sprint-b-plan.md. Client→server: placeBombRequest, detonateRemoteRequest, inputIntent. Server→client: blastEvent, pickupCollected, bomberDied, shieldConsumed, roundResolved, blockDestroyed. New entityId definition reused across the new variants. Schema only — no system code yet. Pre-existing 4 message kinds (world.snapshot, player.join, player.leave, intent.move) untouched.
schemas/protocol.schema.json: 9 new oneOf variants + entityId definition
+10 unit tests in tests/unit/protocol-schema.test.ts covering each new message kind, valid + invalid payload cases, additionalProperties guard
